nodes.name: AcquisitionControl
nodes.description: This category includes items used to set the image acquisition parameters and to start and stop acquisition.

nodes.name: AcquisitionFrameRate
nodes.description: Acquisition frame rate of the camera in frames per second.

nodes.name: AcquisitionFrameRateAbs
nodes.description: Sets the 'absolute' value of the acquisition frame rate. The 'absolute' value is a float value that sets the acquisition frame rate in frames per second.

nodes.name: AcquisitionFrameRateEnable
nodes.description: This boolean value enables setting  the camera's acquisition frame rate to a specified value.

nodes.name: AcquisitionMode
nodes.description: This enumeration sets the image acquisition mode.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStart
nodes.description: This command starts the acquisition of images. If the camera is set for single frame acquisition, it will start acquisition of one frame. If the camera is set for continuous frame acquisition, it will start continuous acquisition of frames.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStatus
nodes.description: This feature is used to read the state (True or False) of the internal acquisition signal selected using AcquisitionStatusSelector.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStatusSelector
nodes.description: This enumeration is used to select which internal acquisition signal to read using AcquisitionStatus.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStop
nodes.description: If the camera is set for continuous image acquisition and acquisition has been started, this command stops the acquisition of images.

nodes.name: AnalogControl
nodes.description: This category includes items that control the analog characteristics of the video signal.

nodes.name: BinningHorizontal
nodes.description: Number of adjacent horizontal pixels to be summed. Their charges will be summed and reported out of the camera as a single pixel.

nodes.name: BinningHorizontalMode
nodes.description: Sets the binning mode for horizontal binning.

nodes.name: BinningVertical
nodes.description: Number of adjacent vertical pixels to be summed. Their charges will be summed and reported out of the camera as a single pixel.

nodes.name: BinningVerticalMode
nodes.description: Sets the binning mode for vertical binning.

nodes.name: BlackLevel
nodes.description: Black level value to be applied to the currently selected sensor tap.

nodes.name: BslCenterX
nodes.description: Centers the image horizontally.

nodes.name: BslCenterY
nodes.description: Centers the image vertically.

nodes.name: DeviceControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters to retrieve information about the current device or to configure the current device.

nodes.name: DeviceDelayRegister
nodes.description: This is a hidden element. It can set a delay that is used after each Read and Write from the device-port.

nodes.name: DeviceFirmwareVersion
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is a string that indicates the version of the device's firmware and software.

nodes.name: DeviceFirmwareVersionOverride
nodes.description: This is a hidden element. It can set a string that indicates the version of the device's firmware and software.

nodes.name: DeviceLinkThroughputLimit
nodes.description: Bandwidth limit for data transmission (in bytes per second).

nodes.name: DeviceLinkThroughputLimitMode
nodes.description: Enables/disables the device link throughput limit. If disabled, the bandwidth used is determined by the settings of various other parameters, e.g., exposure time or frame rate.

nodes.name: DeviceManufacturerInfo
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is a string that provides additional information from the vendor about the camera.

nodes.name: DeviceModelName
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is a text description that indicates the model name of the device.

nodes.name: DeviceTemperatureSelector
nodes.description: Sets the location in the camera where the temperature will be measured. The temperature can be retrieved using the Device Temperature parameter.

nodes.name: DeviceUserID
nodes.description: This is a read/write element. It is a user programmable string.

nodes.name: DeviceVendorName
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is a text description that indicates the name of the device's vendor.

nodes.name: DeviceVersion
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is a string that indicates the version of the device.

nodes.name: DigitalIOControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring the camera's digital I/O lines.

nodes.name: DigitalShift
nodes.description: Digital shift allows you to multiply the pixel values in an image. This increases the brightness of the image. If the parameter is set to zero, digital shift is disabled.

nodes.name: ExposureAuto
nodes.description: Sets the operation mode of the Exposure Auto auto function. The Exposure Auto auto function automatically adjusts the exposure time within set limits until a target brightness value has been reached.

nodes.name: ExposureMode
nodes.description: Sets the exposure mode.

nodes.name: ExposureTime
nodes.description: Exposure time of the camera in microseconds.

nodes.name: ExposureTimeAbs
nodes.description: Controls the emulated absolute exposure time in microseconds (us).

nodes.name: ExposureTimeBaseAbs
nodes.description: Dummy: This float value sets the time base (in microseconds) that is used when the exposure time is set with the 'raw' setting.

nodes.name: ExposureTimeRaw
nodes.description: Dummy: This value sets an integer that will be used as a multiplier for the exposure timebase. The actual exposure time equals the current exposure time raw setting times the current exposure time base abs setting.

nodes.name: ForceFailedBuffer
nodes.description: Marks the next buffer as a failed buffer.

nodes.name: ForceFailedBufferCount
nodes.description: Number of failed buffers to generate.

nodes.name: Gain
nodes.description: Value of the currently selected gain in dB.

nodes.name: GainAuto
nodes.description: Sets the operation mode of the Gain Auto auto function. The Gain Auto auto function automatically adjusts the gain within set limits until a target brightness value has been reached.

nodes.name: GainRaw
nodes.description: Sets the 'raw' value of the selected gain control. The 'raw' value is an integer value that sets the selected gain control in units specific to the camera.

nodes.name: Gamma
nodes.description: Gamma correction to be applied. Gamma correction allows you to optimize the brightness of acquired images for display on a monitor.

nodes.name: GevSCBWR
nodes.description: Percentage of the Ethernet bandwidth assigned to the camera to be held in reserve for packet resends and for the transmission of control data between the camera and the host computer. The setting is expressed as a percentage of the Bandwidth Assigned parameter. For example, if the Bandwidth Assigned parameter indicates that 30 MBytes/s have been assigned to the camera and the Bandwidth Reserve parameter is set to 5 %, the bandwidth reserve will be 1.5 MBytes/s.

nodes.name: GevSCBWRA
nodes.description: Multiplier for the Bandwidth Reserve parameter. The multiplier is used to establish an extra pool of reserved bandwidth that can be used if an unusually large burst of packet resends is needed.

nodes.name: GevSCFTD
nodes.description: Frame transmission delay on the selected stream channel (in ticks). This value sets a delay before transmitting the acquired image.

nodes.name: GevSCPD
nodes.description: Delay between the transmission of each packet on the selected stream channel. The delay is measured in ticks.

nodes.name: GevSCPSPacketSize
nodes.description: Packet size in bytes on the selected stream channel. Excludes data leader and data trailer. (The last packet may be smaller because the packet size is not necessarily a multiple of the block size of the stream channel.)

nodes.name: GigEVision
nodes.description: Contains parameters related to the GigE Vision transport layer of the device.

nodes.name: Height
nodes.description: This value sets the height of the area of interest in pixels.

nodes.name: HeightMax
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is an integer that indicates maximum allowed height of the image in pixels taking into account any function that may limit the allowed height.

nodes.name: ImageCompression
nodes.description: This category includes items that control the compression if image data.

nodes.name: ImageCompressionMode
nodes.description: Enable a specific image compression mode.

nodes.name: ImageCompressionRateOption
nodes.description: Enable a specific image compression mode.

nodes.name: ImageFileMode
nodes.description: Enables loading files from disk for image acquisition.

nodes.name: ImageFilename
nodes.description: Enter the name of an image filename in a format supported by pylon or the path to a directory containing image files.

nodes.name: ImageFormatControl
nodes.description: This category includes items that control the size of the acquired image and the format of the transferred pixel data.

nodes.name: LineInverter
nodes.description: Enables the signal inverter function for the currently selected input or output line.

nodes.name: LineMode
nodes.description: Sets the mode for the selected line. This controls whether the physical line is used to input or output a signal.

nodes.name: LineSelector
nodes.description: Sets the I/O line to be configured. All changes to the line settings will be applied to the selected line.

nodes.name: LineSource
nodes.description: Sets the source signal for the currently selected line. The currently selected line must be an output line.

nodes.name: OffsetX
nodes.description: This value sets the X offset (left offset) for the area of interest in pixels, i.e., the distance in pixels between the left side of the sensor and the left side of the image area.

nodes.name: OffsetY
nodes.description: This value sets the Y offset (top offset) for the area of interest, i.e., the distance in pixels between the top of the sensor and the top of the image area.

nodes.name: PayloadSize
nodes.description: Size of the payload in bytes. This is the total number of bytes sent in the payload. Image data + chunk data if present. No packet headers.

nodes.name: PixelDynamicRangeMax
nodes.description: This is a read only feature. It indicates the maximum possible pixel value that could be transferred from the camera.

nodes.name: PixelDynamicRangeMin
nodes.description: This is a read only feature. It indicates the minimum possible pixel value that could be transferred from the camera.

nodes.name: PixelFormat
nodes.description: This enumeration sets the format of the pixel data transmitted for acquired images.

nodes.name: PixelSize
nodes.description: This is a read only feature. This enumeration provides a list of values that indicate the depth of the pixel values in the acquired images in bits per pixel. This value will always be coherent with the pixel format setting.

nodes.name: ResultingFrameRateAbs
nodes.description: Dummy framerate feature. Does not correspond to the real transferred frame rate.

nodes.name: ReverseX
nodes.description: Enables horizontal mirroring of the image. The pixel values of every line in a captured image will be swapped along the line's center. You can use the ROI feature when using the Reverse X feature. The position of the ROI relative to the sensor remains the same.

nodes.name: ReverseY
nodes.description: Enables vertical mirroring of the image. The pixel values of every column in a captured image will be swapped along the column's center. You can use the ROI feature when using the Reverse Y feature. The position of the ROI relative to the sensor remains the same.

nodes.name: SensorHeight
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is an integer that indicates the actual height of the camera's sensor in pixels.

nodes.name: SensorWidth
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is an integer that indicates the actual width of the camera's sensor in pixels.

nodes.name: TestImageSelector
nodes.description: This enumeration provides a list of the available test images. Selecting a test image from the list will enable the test image.

nodes.name: TransportLayerControl
nodes.description: This category includes items related to the CamEmu transport specification.

nodes.name: TriggerActivation
nodes.description: Sets the type of signal transition that will activate the selected trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerDelay
nodes.description: Trigger delay time in microseconds. The delay is applied after the trigger has been received and before effectively activating the trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerMode
nodes.description: Sets the mode for the currently selected trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerSelector
nodes.description: Sets the trigger type to be configured. All changes to the trigger settings will be applied to the selected trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerSoftware
nodes.description: This command generates a software trigger signal. The software trigger signal will be used if the trigger source is set to 'Software'.

nodes.name: TriggerSource
nodes.description: Sets the source signal for the selected trigger.

nodes.name: UserOutputSelector
nodes.description: Sets the user-settable output signal to be configured. All changes to the user-settable output signal settings will be applied to the selected user-settable output signal.

nodes.name: UserOutputValue
nodes.description: Enables the selected user-settable output line.

nodes.name: Width
nodes.description: This value sets the width of the area of interest in pixels.

nodes.name: WidthMax
nodes.description: This is a read only element. It is an integer that indicates maximum allowed width of the image in pixels taking into account any function that may limit the allowed width.
